turns.question: What was our repeat purchase rate from 1 to 10 October 2026: of the customers who bought in that time, what share bought more than once?
turns.answer: From 1 to 10 October 2026, 10 of the 17 active customers (customers with a non-cancelled order in that period) were repeat customers, meaning they have placed two or more orders in all, so the share is 10 of 17 customers; the semantic layer has no direct repeat-share metric, and its repeat count looks at all orders placed, not only those in this window. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
